verdict.rationale: Puzzle is an accounting platform that advertises 'real-time financial reports with one click,' cash and accrual accounting, and startup metrics (ARR, burn, runway), which implies standard P&L/balance sheet/cash-flow generation as core GL functionality. However, no evidence explicitly names 'balance sheet' or 'cash-flow statement' outputs or shows a hands-on report example. Missing for 10: explicit documentation naming all three statements (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow) with on-demand period selection, and independent/hands-on verification of report accuracy.
